cues.said: stop fixing yourself
now watch what this box does
every box of sea is moving
only one is still
now it began as a dream of the sea
so I took the colors and contained them carefully in boxes
so it goes that we bury secrets in us
and believe we all hold
the same ones
this is directly from a book I wrote
but here's the thing
but you can drown the oceans
we receive the grace of acceptance
and with acceptance comes a calm
change comes through being
not resisting
because it's not what the self
help books tell you to do
you're not supposed to try to become something better
you have to be
and that comes with accepting who you are
accepting the outcome, accepting the life
and then going with the flow
not pushing harder and harder and harder
so let's listen with the stillness
instead of fixing ourselves
just be here
